The '''Watchtower''' was an ancient edifice constructed atop the rock spire west of the [[Dread Fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. The Watchtower was controlled by the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Dread War]], and the upper terrace was only accessible via a portal on the ground that utilized [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]] technology. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zaoron]] oversaw the Watchtower during the Dread War, but the tower was sacked during the fighting and its core recovered, allowing enemy forces to penetrate the [[Dread Fortress]] and defeat the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dread Cavern was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. It is the site of two faction-specific yet identical missions&mdash;"The Hand that Sees" for Imperial players and "Eye of Terror" for Republic players&mdash;and the repeatable Daily version of that mission, "The Tower's Core."<ref name="TOR" />
